entries.title: Complete Dentist Website Implementation
entries.description: Created full production-ready dentist website with Navbar, Hero, Services, About, Testimonials, CTA, and Footer using 'Soft Modern Wellness' design aesthetic

entries.title: Typography Consistency Fix
entries.description: Ensured consistent typography across all components. Added Google Fonts @import to all 6 components and applied Manrope to body text, Plus Jakarta Sans to headings

entries.title: Consolidated Font Imports
entries.description: Moved Google Fonts @import statements into BaseLayout and removed component-level imports to reduce duplicate font requests.

entries.title: Documented MCP Usage
entries.description: Added MCP server usage guidelines to AGENTS.md for proper tool selection and scope.

entries.title: Expanded MCP Instructions
entries.description: Listed available MCP servers and usage steps in AGENTS.md.

entries.title: MCP List Fixup
entries.description: Added sequential-thinking and playwright to MCP list in AGENTS.md.

entries.title: Added MCP Examples
entries.description: Added quick ?when to use? examples for each MCP in AGENTS.md.

entries.title: Created Design Guide
entries.description: Documented the current visual system, tokens, and component patterns in docs/design-guide.md.

entries.title: Use BaseLayout on Index
entries.description: Switched index.astro to BaseLayout and added layout props to control navbar and main padding.

entries.title: Centralized Color Tokens
entries.description: Aligned global.css tokens with the design guide and replaced hardcoded palette values in components.

entries.title: Fix Global Color Tokens
entries.description: Restored design guide palette and nav tokens in global.css; removed nav-only root shadow overrides.

entries.title: Componentized Section Headers
entries.description: Added SectionHeader Astro component and applied it to Services and Testimonials per Astro component props guidance.

entries.title: Hero Mobile Order Fix
entries.description: Adjusted hero layout ordering so text appears before the visual on smaller screens.

entries.title: Removed Placeholder Component
entries.description: Deleted src/components/EXAMPLE.astro to avoid shipping demo content.

entries.title: Improve Featured Service Card Contrast
entries.description: Adjusted featured service card list item text color for better readability on dark background.

entries.title: Fix Mobile Navbar CTA Wrap
entries.description: Reduced CTA button sizing and forced no-wrap on mobile to prevent line breaks.

entries.title: Added Hero Mobile Navigation
entries.description: Implemented a mobile nav toggle in DentistHero with dropdown links and CTA inside the menu.

entries.title: Reduce Hero Mobile Whitespace
entries.description: Adjusted mobile hero padding and visual margins to eliminate excess bottom space.

entries.title: Further Reduce Hero Mobile Whitespace
entries.description: Tightened mobile hero spacing and hid the smile illustration to reduce excess vertical space.

entries.title: Reduce Services Headline Size on Mobile
entries.description: Decreased mobile Services section headline size to prevent truncation.

entries.title: SectionHeader Mobile Typography
entries.description: Added a mobile breakpoint in SectionHeader to reduce heading size on small screens.
